tagline: 美能达微型相机，1950 年发布
description: 美能达于1950年推出的微型相机。配备Chiyoko Rokkor 1:3.5/25mm (3 elements), focusing fixed。快门速度slider shutter, speeds 1/25 to 1/200 sec., flash synchronized。使用Konan cartridge for 16mm, allowing midroll film exchange。

specs.胶片/画幅: Konan cartridge for 16mm, allowing midroll film exchange
specs.快门: slider shutter, speeds 1/25 to 1/200 sec., flash synchronized
specs.英文简介: The Konan-16 Automat was Chiyoda's first subminiature camera for 16mm film.
